newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe's Merspin Ltd seeks exchange listing.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe's Merspin Ltd seeks exchange listing.

text.p: Merspin Ltd, an associate company of Zimbabwe's largest towel manufacturer, Merlin Ltd, will next month seek a listing on the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange (ZSE).
Merlin, currently suspended from the ZSE, was put into provisional liquidation last year and Merspin plans to take over the firm.

"Merlin should come out of temporary liquidation on or about April 25 and revert to being a normal operating company. When that happens, it will be delisted from the ZSE and Merspin will be listed," Merspin chief executive Bruce Hulley said in a statement.
Merspin would thereafter directly and indirectly invest Z$40 million in Merlin and financial creditors would convert a portion of their claims against Merlin into medium-term equity in Merspin.
Hulley said Merspin will be offering Merlin shareholders 75 cents a share. Three Merspin shares valued at 175 cents each will be issued for every seven Merlin shares held.
